checks.name: required_envelope
checks.description: Output envelope must include text, provider, model, usage, cost_usd, latency_ms, trace_id, and audit_seq

checks.name: trace_id_format
checks.description: Trace ID must be a non-empty string stripped of surrounding whitespace

checks.name: usage_metrics_non_negative
checks.description: Usage prompt_tokens and completion_tokens must be >= 0 with total_tokens consistent

checks.name: cost_and_latency_bounds
checks.description: cost_usd and latency_ms must be non-negative numeric floats

checks.name: content_presence
checks.description: Completion text must be a valid non-empty string and provider must be specified
